say:1:1720957001:1.text: There you are, detective! We're almost done here. By tomorrow morning, this story will be on the front page of the Savannah Morning Post, and the whole city will be reading it!
say:1:1720957001:1.male: There you are, detective! We're almost done here. By tomorrow morning, this story will be on the front page of the Savannah Morning Post, and the whole city will be reading it!
say:1:1720957001:1.female: There you are, detective! We're almost done here. By tomorrow morning, this story will be on the front page of the Savannah Morning Post, and the whole city will be reading it!

say:2:1720957002:1.text: Oh! Commander Hendrik. What an unexpected honor!
say:2:1720957002:1.source_cn: 唉哟，这不是亨德里克司令嘛！幸会幸会！失敬失敬！

say:3:1720957003:1.text: You two came together... does that mean you got Viscount Demit?
say:3:1720957003:1.source_cn: 二位一同前来……是抓捕德米特子爵的事有结果了？

choice_prompt:4:1720957003.text: You two came together... does that mean you got Viscount Demit?
choice_prompt:4:1720957003.source_cn: 二位一同前来……是抓捕德米特子爵的事有结果了？

say:5:1720957004:1.text: What? Someone warned him?! Wait... so that's what that was. He wasn't taking the family out on trip. He was getting out while he still could!
say:5:1720957004:1.source_cn: 啊？！是谁走漏了风声吗！不对，我想想……我说他怎么会突...

choice_prompt:6:1720957004.text: What? Someone warned him?! Wait... so that's what that was. He wasn't taking the family out on trip. He was getting out while he still could!
choice_prompt:6:1720957004.source_cn: 啊？！是谁走漏了风声吗！不对，我想想……我说他怎么会突然带着全家老小出门呢，难道那个时候他就……！

say:7:1720957005:1.text: Well... I was mostly looking into that five-thousand-gold "Municipal Emergency Fund". People eat that kind of story up—nobles skimming money and all that. Other than that, nothing really stood out to me.
say:7:1720957005:1.source_cn: 嗯……我那部分主要是在深挖他那个5000金币的市政工程...

say:8:1720957006:1.text: What about you, Haria? Did you notice anything odd?
say:8:1720957006:1.source_cn: 赫蒂奇，你那部分呢？有什么奇怪的地方吗？

say:9:1720957007:1.text: Actually... yeah. That employment list felt strange. If Demit was getting ready to run, why was he offering double pay to hire new people?
say:9:1720957007:1.source_cn: 我觉得那份人员雇佣名单有点奇怪，德米特子爵既然已经要逃...

say:11:1720957008:1.text: That gives you something to work with. You go back over the clues again.
say:11:1720957008:1.source_cn: 马斯卡和赫蒂奇的话，给了你新的思路，让你决定重新审视手...
say:11:1720957008:1.male: That gives you something to work with. You go back over the clues again.
say:11:1720957008:1.female: That gives you something to work with. You go back over the clues again.

say:12:1720957009:1.text: Maybe if you piece those scattered details together a different way, you can figure out where Demit was really headed.
say:12:1720957009:1.source_cn: 将这些看似无关的信息重新组合，或许就能推理出他逃亡的真...
say:12:1720957009:1.male: Maybe if you piece those scattered details together a different way, you can figure out where Demit was really headed.
say:12:1720957009:1.female: Maybe if you piece those scattered details together a different way, you can figure out where Demit was really headed.

say:15:1720961001:1.text: Demit used a fake public works project as cover while funneling newspaper funds into planks, rope, and other supplies to repair a boat. He even hired a boatman.
say:15:1720961001:1.source_cn: 德米特子爵一方面利用自己的职权杜撰了一项市政工程项目，...
say:15:1720961001:1.male: Demit used a fake public works project as cover while funneling newspaper funds into planks, rope, and other supplies to repair a boat. He even hired a boatman.
say:15:1720961001:1.female: Demit used a fake public works project as cover while funneling newspaper funds into planks, rope, and other supplies to repair a boat. He even hired a boatman.

say:16:1720961002:1.text: He was using the so-called public works project to cover what he was really doing: fixing up a boat so he could escape by water if things went south.
say:16:1720961002:1.source_cn: 他在以市政工程为名掩盖自己的行动——修缮船只，并在时机...
say:16:1720961002:1.male: He was using the so-called public works project to cover what he was really doing: fixing up a boat so he could escape by water if things went south.
say:16:1720961002:1.female: He was using the so-called public works project to cover what he was really doing: fixing up a boat so he could escape by water if things went south.

say:18:1720961003:1.text: Fixing a boat... hiring a boatman... getting out by boat! If that's the plan, then he needs a place to leave from...
say:18:1720961003:1.source_cn: 修船……招船工……乘船潜逃！那他一定需要一个地方出发……

say:20:1720961005:1.text: Exactly! The lower district dock. It's crowded, chaotic, and bustling with people who don't ask questions. If Demit wanted to disappear without drawing attention, that's where he'd go!
say:20:1720961005:1.source_cn: 没错！就是下城区的码头！那里势力交错，鱼龙混杂，最适合...

say:21:1720961006:1.text: Damn it... We locked down the roads and never stopped to think he might leave by river.
say:21:1720961006:1.source_cn: 该死……我们在陆路严加布防，却忽略了水路。

say:22:1720961007:1.text: Alright. We head for the dock right now. If we move fast, we may still catch him before he gets away!
say:22:1720961007:1.source_cn: 我们立刻动身前往下城区码头，或许还来得及在他离港前将他截住！

choice:6:0:1.text: A man in that kind of hurry usually leaves something behind.
choice:6:0:1.source_cn: 他逃跑时，很可能留下了线索
choice:6:0:1.male: A man in that kind of hurry usually leaves something behind.
choice:6:0:1.female: A man in that kind of hurry usually leaves something behind.

choice:6:1:2.text: While you were writing, did anything start to look off?
choice:6:1:2.source_cn: 你们写报道时，有没有发现新疑点
choice:6:1:2.male: While you were writing, did anything start to look off?
choice:6:1:2.female: While you were writing, did anything start to look off?

choice:4:1:2.source_cn: 德米特子爵畏罪潜逃了
